title: Botswana LUCT CMS — FSD knowledge graph

nodes.label: Botswana CMS
nodes.summary: LUCT Botswana (BWA-GBE) PHPMaker campus CMS under botswana/campus/<desk>/, all desks sharing MySQL cmsbotswana. Same LUCT desk tree and app_* family as Cyberjaya, plus the Botswana-only DTEF → TEF.gov.bw scholarship sync.
nodes.raisd: M5 expansion reference, not ADR-1 SoR. Closest sister to Cyberjaya — cleaner ACL transfer than Sierra Leone EMS. Portal API must stay campus-keyed (CAP-53).

nodes.label: Academic
nodes.summary: Registry, faculty, lecturer, CDU (AQA) and training desks around student master, programmes, modules, attendance and results.

nodes.label: Student life
nodes.summary: Services (welfare, visa, insurance), accommodation, library, noticeboard and a thin student self-service app. Welfare/accommodation are thicker (w_* / acc_*) than Sierra Leone.

nodes.label: Commercial
nodes.summary: Marketing intake (app_*, agents), bursary ledger with assist / DTEF billing, and the DTEF scholarship queue that syncs to TEF.gov.bw.

nodes.label: Platform
nodes.summary: Setup (institution, terms, fee catalogs, user levels), reporting, botsbatch ops scripts and api_* / portal_*_botswana hooks.

nodes.label: registry/
nodes.summary: Student master, offers, forms, transcripts and the DTEF scholarship queue (~894 PHP files — largest desk).
nodes.raisd: Student + Staff portals via Portal API; registry remains SoR for Botswana.

nodes.label: faculty/
nodes.summary: Schools, programmes, modules, timetable, attendance and results (~333 PHP).
nodes.raisd: Student / Lecturer / Staff academic surfaces read through Portal API.

nodes.label: lecturer/
nodes.summary: Lecturer screens for marks, attendance and module materials (~122 PHP).
nodes.raisd: Lecturer portal via Portal API.

nodes.label: cdu/
nodes.summary: AQA / programme accreditation desks — entry requirements and accreditation (~207 PHP).
nodes.raisd: Staff surface for programme approvals evidence.

nodes.label: training/
nodes.summary: Short-course / training enrolment (~202 PHP).
nodes.raisd: Later staff surface; not a launch capability.

nodes.label: services/
nodes.summary: Welfare, counselling, visa and insurance operations (~308 PHP).
nodes.raisd: Staff Services surface; student visa view via Portal API.

nodes.label: accommodation/
nodes.summary: Dorms, occupants and room charges (~118 PHP). Thicker than Sierra Leone — may need earlier staff-portal surfaces for Botswana.
nodes.raisd: Accommodation request UX (student) and staff housing desk.

nodes.label: library/
nodes.summary: Library desks (~121 PHP).
nodes.raisd: Digital library access candidate.

nodes.label: notice/
nodes.summary: Bulletin / noticeboard (~79 PHP).
nodes.raisd: Portal announcements candidate.

nodes.label: student/
nodes.summary: Thin PHPMaker student self-service (~38 PHP).
nodes.raisd: Superseded by the Raisd student portal via Portal API.

nodes.label: marketing/
nodes.summary: Applications, agents and recruitment (~235 PHP). Same app_* naming as Cyberjaya.
nodes.raisd: Applicant portal via Portal API.

nodes.label: bursary/
nodes.summary: Invoices, payments, receipts and assist / DTEF billing (~452 PHP). Finance assist is a separate path from the registry TEF admission POST.
nodes.raisd: Student Finance read + Staff Bursary via Portal API.

nodes.label: DTEF sync
nodes.summary: Registry saves r_scholarshipapp with status 31 (Sent by Registry) → fetch CSRF token → POST HAL+JSON program_of_study to tef.gov.bw. 32 = success/duplicate, 33 = error; 34 Approved / 35 Rejected recorded later.
nodes.raisd: Campus feature flag + secret store. Portal API must own any future TEF client — never browser → TEF.

nodes.label: tef.gov.bw
nodes.summary: Botswana Tertiary Education Fund government API (Drupal HAL+JSON). No Cyberjaya or Sierra Leone equivalent.
nodes.raisd: External dependency behind a campus feature flag; secrets stay server-side.

nodes.label: setup/
nodes.summary: Institution, terms, fee catalogs and user levels (~756 PHP).
nodes.raisd: Campus configuration input for CAP-53 campus keying.

nodes.label: reporting/
nodes.summary: Population, enrolment, payment and scholarship reports (~211 PHP).
nodes.raisd: Staff reporting surfaces later; read-only.

nodes.label: botsbatch
nodes.summary: Ops scripts (not committed) refreshing portal, exam, registry and bursary slices.
nodes.raisd: Replace with campus-keyed Portal API sync at M5.

nodes.label: api_* hooks
nodes.summary: api_student_* / api_faculty_* stored procedures and portal_*_botswana tables feed external clients today.
nodes.raisd: Candidate read surface for the future Portal API ACL — Sierra Leone has no equivalent.

nodes.label: r_student
nodes.summary: Shared student record hub in cmsbotswana. Registry/marketing enrol; faculty, bursary, lecturer, services and accommodation attach to it.
nodes.raisd: Identity and enrolment source for campus-keyed Portal API reads.

nodes.label: Portal API
nodes.summary: Raisd anti-corruption layer. Applicant, student, lecturer and staff portals call only the Portal API; it reaches cmsbotswana campus-keyed at M5+.
nodes.raisd: CAP-53 campus-keyed ACL; owns any TEF client.

nodes.label: CAP-04
nodes.summary: Institution, programme and delivery-site approvals.

nodes.label: CAP-31
nodes.summary: Digital library and e-resources.

nodes.label: CAP-44
nodes.summary: Lecturer workspace and course access.

nodes.label: CAP-45
nodes.summary: Finance balances, invoices and payment history.

nodes.label: CAP-47
nodes.summary: Online payment and financial documents.

nodes.label: CAP-48
nodes.summary: Scholarships and incentives — SoR today is registry + bursary; student portal read-only awards later.

nodes.label: CAP-50
nodes.summary: Immigration and visa processing.

nodes.label: CAP-52
nodes.summary: Accommodation management.

nodes.label: CAP-53
nodes.summary: Existing CMS integration and campus configuration (campus-keyed ACL).
